description: The verdict record for one vetted candidate. One record per candidate per vetting run, written by the gauntlet (rawflux_results.json carries the desk-check stage; this record is the whole-run verdict). A record with final_verdict CANDIDATE is a candidate, not a discovery: confirmation needs imaging or RV, and nothing here authorises a public claim on its own.

calibration_sha256.description: sha256 over the calibration CONTENT hashes (not just the labels): the profiles' bytes are part of the computation's identity.

calibration_version.description: Versioned calibration profiles that produced this record, as a per-subsystem map, e.g. {"bulk": "v1"} (see calibration/). Threshold changes bump the version; records from different calibrations are never silently mixed. A plain string is a legacy 1.1 record and still validates.

ephemeris_used.description: The ephemeris the vetting actually folded on (refined period for bulk survivors — see docs/vetting-manual.md stage 2).

source.description: How the ephemeris was set, e.g. 'phase-scan refinement' or 'filed'.

filed.description: The ephemeris as filed by the screen or sweep.

final_verdict.description: Whole-run verdict. CANDIDATE means the signal survived every gate so far — it is still not a confirmed planet.

holdout_verdict.description: Leave-one-sector-out prediction test. PASS proves predictive periodicity only — a clean EB passes.

imaging.description: Centroid / difference-imaging localisation. Mandatory before any discovery claim.

blend_host_tic.description: TIC ID of the blend host, when the source is a neighbour.

offset_arcsec.description: Centroid offset from the target, arcseconds.

offset_px.description: Centroid offset from the target, pixels.

on_target.description: True when the source localises to the target star.

pipeline_git_sha.description: Short git SHA of the pipeline code that produced this record ('unknown' when git was unavailable).

rawflux_verdict.description: Desk-check verdict on the unflattened flux.

run_id.description: Unique id of the run that produced this record, e.g. 'bulk-20261114T063000Z-a1b2'.

schema_version.description: Provenance schema version: '1.2' (current). '1.1' records are legacy and still validate.

T23_T14.description: Flat-bottom fraction. <= 0.30 is V-shaped/grazing; >= 0.50 is U-shaped.

density_flag.description: True when the fitted duration is impossible for a circular-orbit planet on this star.

artifacts.description: Paths/ids of evidence files behind this result.

config_hash.description: sha256 of the configuration the tool ran with.

detection_limit.description: Faintest signal this stage could have seen, same units as value.

execution_status.description: Execution outcome, separate from the scientific outcome: a crashed tool is 'error' with status 'unmeasured', never a scientific fail.

input_hashes.description: sha256 hashes of the inputs this result was computed from, keyed by input name.

metrics.description: Stage-specific numbers that do not fit the fixed evidence fields (e.g. TRICERATOPS FPP/NFPP — preserved, never reduced to a bare pass/fail).

threshold.description: The pass bar in the same units as value. Null when the stage is a classification, not a thresholded measurement.

tool_version.description: Version of the tool that produced this result.

value.description: The measured quantity (e.g. fold depth %), in the same units as uncertainty/threshold.

stages.description: Typed gauntlet stage results (gauntlet/stage_result.py), keyed by stage name. A stage at status 'unmeasured' means not yet vetted — never a pass. See the if/then rule below: a CANDIDATE verdict requires every listed stage at 'pass'.

tic.description: TESS Input Catalog ID (string, as written by the gauntlet tools).

timestamp_utc.description: Run start, ISO 8601 UTC (e.g. 2026-11-14T06:00:00+00:00). One timestamp per run.

verdict_note.description: One-paragraph human-readable justification for the final verdict, with the decisive evidence.

working_tree_clean.description: Whether the working tree was clean when this record was produced. A git SHA with no dirty flag misleads whenever uncommitted code runs. null when git was unavailable.

title: Gauntlet verdict record
